prompts.name: RIFF
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one character-and-kart concept model sheet for a polished 3D arcade racing game, intended as a Blender modeling reference.
Input image 1 is the user's monster lineup: use only the specifically selected monster as character design reference. Develop that recognizable creature into a charming little racer, retaining its characteristic color, eye count, horn or ear structure, and silhouette.
Style: premium stylized 3D animated-feature / collectible designer-toy finish, rounded appealing forms, expressive mischievous face, clean purposeful detailing, soft skin/fur as appropriate, satin automotive paint, rubber tires and restrained brushed metal. Cartoon proportions with believable functional construction. Cohesive game art, not photorealism, no gritty damage, no imitation brand logos.
Composition: a clean high-resolution landscape character design sheet on warm ivory background, four spacious panels arranged 2x2. Top left a polished front three-quarter hero view; top right a straight front view; bottom left an exact side profile; bottom right a straight rear view. The SAME ONE monster and SAME ONE kart in all four views, identical geometry, proportions, colors and detail. All views full body of kart and complete character including horns, no cropping. Modest soft contact shadows, even studio lighting, sharply readable surfaces. Small simple uppercase view labels; one compact character name header. No prose, no stats, no fake measurements, no decorative logos.
The racer is ALWAYS seated inside its vehicle in every view, hands on a reachable steering wheel, feet contained in footwell, seat supporting body, no standing character and no detached anatomy. Open cockpit keeps face and signature silhouette visible from the driving camera. Exactly four chunky wheels with axles and useful ground clearance; front/rear views show corresponding near wheels with physically consistent positioning. One shared arcade-kart scale across roster, each cockpit sized for its monster. Compact rounded kart, not a full-size automobile or realistic race car. Stable shape design suitable for eventual 3D modeling. Reference footer labels and logos are not part of the requested artwork.

Character name header: RIFF
Select TOP ROW FIRST from the user lineup: turquoise/teal squat monster, two large smooth dark teal loop-shaped horns curling inward, little teal hair tufts, two half-lidded eyes and broad cheeky grin with small teeth, pale aqua muzzle and belly. Maintain its two eyes and loop horns. Racer personality: relaxed confidence. Kart: a compact pearl-cream and turquoise rounded speedster, a single coral accent stripe, broad low nose, exposed dark rubber wheels with teal hubs, simple oval side pods, neatly integrated small rear motor and twin short exhausts. Keep horns clear of cockpit and rear silhouette.
